title: NFL Football
description:
Cleveland Browns at Pittsburgh Steelers
The Pittsburgh Steelers host the Cleveland Browns in AFC North play at Acrisure Stadium. Both sides enter at 5-2, but Cleveland beat Pittsburgh, 27-24, just a month ago, while Pittsburgh defeated New Orleans, 16-10, in last week's matchup.

title: NFL Football
description:
Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos
The Broncos (5-2) host the Chiefs (5-1) in NFL Week 8 at Empower Field at Mile High. Denver arrives off three straight wins after beating Arizona, while Kansas City remains first in the AFC West, despite a 20-3 defeat against Seattle last week.
